benefit.name: St. Albert Transit & Recreation Subsidy
benefit.amount: Free local fares within St. Albert + free annual recreation membership for AISH and ADAP recipients
benefit.summary: St. Albert's subsidy gives eligible residents free local fares within St. Albert and free local Handibus tickets for approved riders. AISH and ADAP recipients are eligible for a free annual membership at City-run recreation facilities.
benefit.note: AISH and ADAP recipients are eligible for a free annual recreation membership. The City's page also says your total annual household income (before taxes) must be within the low-income limits set by Statistics Canada. It does not say whether that rule applies to AISH or ADAP recipients, so confirm with the City.
benefit.applyText: Open the official page on stalbert.ca

detail.about: St. Albert's Family and Community Support Services runs one subsidy covering transit and recreation. For eligible residents: free local fares within St. Albert; free local tickets for approved Handibus riders for travel within St. Albert; 65% off monthly adult commuter fares for travel between St. Albert and Edmonton; AISH and ADAP recipients are eligible for a free annual membership at City-run recreation facilities, including Servus Credit Union Place, Fountain Park Recreation Centre and Grosvenor Outdoor Pool.

aboutList.lead: St. Albert's Family and Community Support Services runs one subsidy covering transit and recreation. For eligible residents:
items: Free local fares within St. Albert
Free local tickets for approved Handibus riders for travel within St. Albert
65% off monthly adult commuter fares for travel between St. Albert and Edmonton
AISH and ADAP recipients are eligible for a free annual membership at City-run recreation facilities, including Servus Credit Union Place, Fountain Park Recreation Centre and Grosvenor Outdoor Pool

steps: Fill in the subsidy application on the City's subsidy page.
Say that you receive AISH or ADAP — AISH and ADAP recipients are eligible for the free annual recreation membership.
If you use the Handibus, ask about approved-rider status at the same time.
documents: Proof you receive AISH or ADAP
Proof of a St. Albert address
tips: You can't claim this if another source already funds the same thing. If a program already pays your bus fare, sort that out first.
The commuter fare between St. Albert and Edmonton is separate from free local fares. Ask about both if you travel in.

values.note: Free local fares + free annual rec membership (AISH/ADAP)
